faqs.q: What is a 6 in 300# lug butterfly valve (carbon steel, EPDM seat) used for?
faqs.a: This is a 6 in lug-style butterfly valve rated 740 psi (ANSI 300), with a cast WCB carbon steel body, carbon steel disc, EPDM seat and gear operator. It is for mid-pressure hot-water and steam-condensate service.

faqs.q: What end connections does the 6 in 300# lug butterfly valve (carbon steel, EPDM seat) have?
faqs.a: The valve has 6 in 300# ANSI lug ends, full port. Its 6 in 300# ANSI lug body has threaded lug holes that accept stud bolts directly, which allows dead-end service and downstream-flange removal without depressurising upstream.

faqs.q: Should I choose a lug or wafer body for the 6 in 300# lug butterfly valve (carbon steel, EPDM seat)?
faqs.a: This valve is a lug body. Lug bodies take threaded lug holes with stud bolts and allow dead-end service and downstream-flange removal, while wafer bodies sit between two flanges and are lighter and cheaper. Choose lug if the line may be broken downstream.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the 6 in 300# lug butterfly valve (carbon steel, EPDM seat)?
faqs.a: The 6 in 300# lug butterfly valve (carbon steel, EPDM seat) is rated 740 psi working pressure at ANSI 300. Butterfly valves are for isolation and on-off service, and throttling needs the optional positioner and actuator package; never use it above its class rating.

faqs.q: What are the body and disc of the 6 in 300# lug butterfly valve (carbon steel, EPDM seat) made from?
faqs.a: On the 6 in lug valve the body is cast WCB carbon steel and the disc is carbon steel disc, both listed for standard service, not sour service. Confirm the materials against your line specification on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What seat does the 6 in 300# lug butterfly valve (carbon steel, EPDM seat) have and when is it suitable?
faqs.a: The seat on the 6 in lug valve is EPDM seat. Choose the seat from the fluid and temperature, and state both on the RFQ so the seat material is confirmed.

faqs.q: What standard does the 6 in 300# lug butterfly valve (carbon steel, EPDM seat) meet?
faqs.a: The 6 in 300# lug butterfly valve (carbon steel, EPDM seat) is listed to API 609, standard service, with mill test reports to EN 10204 3.1 / 3.2. It is a utility isolation valve, not a sour-service valve, so ask for a different listing for H2S.

faqs.q: How is the 6 in 300# lug butterfly valve (carbon steel, EPDM seat) operated?
faqs.a: The 6 in 300# lug butterfly valve (carbon steel, EPDM seat) is gear-operated. State the operator and any actuator or positioner you need on the RFQ; a lever suits small bore, while a gear operator is used where the torque is too high for a lever.

faqs.q: Where is the 6 in 300# lug butterfly valve (carbon steel, EPDM seat) used?
faqs.a: It is used for hot-water utility headers, steam-condensate return, high-temperature process water and 300# refinery utility lines. It fits ANSI 300 flanges of 6 in nominal size; see [butterfly valves](/c/oilfield-butterfly-valves) and the [Demco butterfly valve part number guide](/blog/demco-butterfly-valve-part-numbers).

faqs.q: How does the 6 in 300# lug butterfly valve (carbon steel, EPDM seat) differ from the 10 in 150# lug valve?
